integrity: Proof based on normalized Haar pushforward and source-defined Hardy norm; finite checker auxiliary, not proof of infinite identities. No independent review performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical unweighted Hardy-space kernel on (a,0,0); no full-domain or weighted-space kernel. The boundary asymptotics concern |a| approaching 1 on this fibre. Historical implicit coverage remains possible.
title: Exact central-fibre Szegő kernel and fractional evaluation blowup for the pentablock
